en: A black-and-white photograph depicting a group of men, likely workers, handling large wooden barrels in a historic stone-paved square. The men are dressed in traditional clothing from an earlier era. The background shows an ornate medieval stone building with arches and decorative reliefs above the entrance. The atmosphere is bustling, suggesting a scene from daily life, possibly related to wine or olive oil production or transport.
